messages:
maya: Hey product — want to align on a micro-rotating design partner pilot for Private/Dedicated next quarter. Thinking 6 partners, 3-week cycles, tight feedback loops and observable success criteria. Thoughts?

jonah: +1. What's the primary success metric here — adoption, latency, or regression counts? :thinking_face:

maya: Primary = time-to-first-success (TTFS) — target < 2 days for basic flows + SLA adherence (P95 latency under test load). Secondary = partner NPS >= 8 and actionable eval counts <= 2 per week.

kelly: For recruitment, split into two buckets: early integrators (platform teams) and product integrators (feature teams). Match the workload to Dedicated vs Private. Also need an NDA + data handling checklist before onboarding.

alex: Ops question: do we require a standard rollout playbook (canary -> expand -> full)? we should include automatic fallback to hosted model for safety.

sam: Are we running eval harnesses on partner prompts? Need partner prompt sets + golden outputs. How often do we run regressions — nightly or before each expand?

maya: Plan: harness runs nightly on partner prompts; we do a weekly manual review for borderline regs. Regressions surface in Optimize dashboard with severity tags.

jonah: Keep feedback tight: weekly 30-min working session + shared Miro + async Jira tickets. Also create a dedicated Slack channel per partner for day-to-day.

kelly: Recruitment incentives suggestion: 3 months discounted usage + engineering time credit. Will confirm finance constraints.

alex: Draft gating criteria: 1) ENG POC assigned, 2) willingness to share representative prompt flows, 3) agreement to weekly syncs, 4) minimal regulatory blockers.

sam: Quick gating rubric draft:
```
score = (eng_poc?10:0) + (prompts_shared?25:0) + (privacy_ok?25:0) + (slo_targets_set?15:0) + (sync_commit?10:0)
accept if score >= 60
```

maya: Nice — add 'regulatory constraints' as a veto and 'expected traffic' as a prioritization factor.

jonah: Timeline check: can infra provision a Private site in 2 weeks per partner? we should be conservative.

alex: Template provisioning is ~3 days, region/setup + QA ~5 days. If no other blockers, 2 weeks is realistic.

maya: OK: recruit this week, onboarding next week, cycle starts in ~3 weeks. I'll draft outreach copy.

kelly: Outreach draft note: short bullets + a 3-question questionnaire. Post when ready and I'll route to legal & finance.

maya: Outreach draft: "We’re running a 3-week micro-pilot to test Redwood Private + Dedicated for your team. Benefits: priority infra, engineering support, discounted usage. Ask: share 3 representative prompt flows and join weekly 30-min syncs. Interested? Reply with 'yes' and your ENG POC."

sam: Add explicit opt-in for logs retention and eval use.

jonah: Also define stop conditions: e.g., regression severity threshold or sustained latency breaches -> rollback to hosted.

maya: Proposed stop conditions: regression severity >= 2 for >24h OR P95 > 2x baseline for >12h. Escape hatch = enable cached hosted endpoint + pause traffic.

kelly: I'll loop in legal and finance. One question: who owns partner success after pilot PD or CS?

alex: PD owns technical onboarding, hand off to CS after 6 weeks for long-term success.

maya: Thanks — I'll update the pilot doc with rubric, outreach copy, stop conditions, and create partner channels. Ping me with edits. :rocket:
